summary: /music volume <percent> controls playback loudness (0-200%, 100 = normal), applying immediately if something's playing and persisting for whatever plays next.
details: Backed by discord.py's PCMVolumeTransformer wrapping the stream. Discord's own slash-command UI enforces the 0-200 range; MusicPlayer refuses an out-of-range value as defense-in-depth.
limitations: Volume is in-memory only, like now-playing state -- resets to 100% on a restart or a Discord Gateway reconnect, the same limitation the rest of the session's playback state already has.
